hooks.name: Canvas Code Review
hooks.description: After saving game.js, an agent reviews the canvas code quality — checks save/restore pairing, render-loop allocations, and style consistency.

action.prompt: A game source file was just saved. Review the change and check: (1) Are all canvas draw calls properly wrapped in ctx.save()/ctx.restore()? (2) Are there any obvious performance issues like creating objects inside the render loop? (3) Does the change maintain the existing code style and naming conventions? Report any issues found.
